fact: The government's health policy brief states that the ministry's integrated hospital information system, which centralises medical, administrative and financial data, has been developed and deployed in all public hospitals of the twelve regions, while a separate information system for primary health care establishments is still being deployed; the brief carries no date of its own, so the December 2024 posting date is used.
title: Politiques publiques en matière de la Santé et de la Protection Sociale
